Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App CPU saturated while host CPU and memory remain normal
Probable_Root_Cause: Container cgroup CPU quota reached or thread-pool exhaustion

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Host CPU high but App CPU normal/low; outbound drops
Probable_Root_Cause: External rogue process or container on host stealing CPU cores

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Inbound errors high while inbound latency drops to minimum
Probable_Root_Cause: Credential stuffing WAF blocking scraper flood 401/403/429

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Inbound BPS high with low RPS and high memory saturation
Probable_Root_Cause: Multipart file upload storm payload uncompressed JSON Slowloris attack

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Inbound latency drops to zero with 200 OK and zero outbound calls
Probable_Root_Cause: Auth middleware bypass regression empty body return cached mock leak

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Outbound BPS spikes while Outbound RPS and saturation remain normal
Probable_Root_Cause: Unbounded query results large file downloads data exfiltration

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App memory pinned at high watermark with CPU spikes from GC threads
Probable_Root_Cause: Full GC pause memory compaction freeze runtime heap lockup

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Inbound errors up (499/408) with near-zero downstream impact
Probable_Root_Cause: Client drops connection prematurely slow mobile networks

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App memory hits cgroup limit causing kernel page reclamation thrashing
Probable_Root_Cause: Application heap/buffer leak approaching container limit / OOM-kill

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Host memory high while App memory is normal; app starved of cache/buffers
Probable_Root_Cause: Co-located container eating host RAM triggering kernel page scanning

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App memory pinned near 0% while App CPU is pinned at 100%
Probable_Root_Cause: GOMEMLIMIT/heap target set too low; runtime in continuous GC thrash

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: High inbound 499s while outbound traffic continues running normally
Probable_Root_Cause: Missing context cancellation; backend work proceeds for cancelled client requests

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Zero inbound traffic with high CPU and surging outbound broker retry errors
Probable_Root_Cause: Unparseable queue message repeatedly nack-ed and redriven by workers

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Traffic flows normally but container cgroup exporter drops out
Probable_Root_Cause: cgroup fs mount error kubelet stats provider stall or scraper timeout

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Traffic and App metrics healthy but node-level hardware metrics missing
Probable_Root_Cause: node_exporter daemon down systemd unit crash or host firewall drop

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Outbound completely stopped but inbound returns fast healthy 200s
Probable_Root_Cause: Circuit breaker tripped serving degraded local cache or empty response

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Both App and Host CPU pinned near 100% while memory is stable
Probable_Root_Cause: Inbound compute volume exceeded physical host CPU cores

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Outbound latency/errors surge and backpressure into ingress
Probable_Root_Cause: Downstream API DB lock contention or remote timeout

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Extreme inbound latency with zero CPU and no 5xx errors
Probable_Root_Cause: Deadlock mutex starvation connection pool leak uncompleted requests

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: OutRPS to InRPS ratio spikes far above historical norm
Probable_Root_Cause: Cascading client retries or unbounded fan-out loops

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Outbound attempts stay up while outbound timeouts explode
Probable_Root_Cause: Switch/router failure egress security group drop routing loop

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Host memory exhausted causing OS page swapping; CPU drops due to I/O wait
Probable_Root_Cause: Host swapping pages to disk; disk I/O blocks runloops across containers

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App memory drops to near 0% after 100% breach; crash loop restarts
Probable_Root_Cause: Kernel OOM-killer terminated container (SIGKILL); pod restarting

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Host memory pinned at 100%; kswapd pegs Host CPU at 100%; total freeze
Probable_Root_Cause: Host physical RAM exhausted; kswapd thrashing kernel page alloc locks

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: App memory flat near 0% with 0% CPU; incoming requests fail instantly (502)
Probable_Root_Cause: Process deadlocked in pre-main init phase; runtime heap unallocated

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Host memory at 100% with random service restarts and network drops
Probable_Root_Cause: Linux OOM-killer killing random background processes and sidecars

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Fast failure on inbound/outbound connection creation with normal CPU/memory
Probable_Root_Cause: EMFILE or EADDRNOTAVAIL socket leak connection pool exhausting ulimit

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Outbound traffic drops with fast DNS resolution failures; ingress times out
Probable_Root_Cause: CoreDNS outage VPC resolver throttle corrupted resolv.conf

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Latency surges despite zero App/Host CPU usage; hypervisor steal time pinned
Probable_Root_Cause: AWS burst credit balance exhaustion or noisy hypervisor neighbor

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Severe inbound queueing and outbound collapse while saturation is entirely unknown
Probable_Root_Cause: node_exporter or cgroup telemetry crash during critical CPU/memory exhaustion

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: All metrics inside baseline quantiles
Probable_Root_Cause: Nominal operating conditions

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Proportional out/in scaling without latency or error growth
Probable_Root_Cause: Organic client traffic surge absorbed cleanly

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Proportional traffic decline with stable latencies
Probable_Root_Cause: Diurnal or scheduled off-peak traffic drop

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: High ingress with low egress and nominal latencies/errors
Probable_Root_Cause: In-memory cache absorbing reads cleanly (e.g. Redis / CDN)

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Metrics fully functional with saturation floor near 0% under lightweight async load
Probable_Root_Cause: Efficient non-blocking event loop or runtime idling at true zero consumption

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: All metrics idle down to baseline floor without errors
Probable_Root_Cause: Clean cessation of incoming requests

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Zero ingress traffic with high CPU and high outbound traffic
Probable_Root_Cause: Background job processing Kafka consumer drain batch sync

Key_Distinguishing_Signature: Clean linear decline of traffic without error spike during deployment cycle
